en: A knife blade is a wedge, which is actually just two inclined planes pushed back-to-back.
Ice skates glide easily because the friction and pressure melt a microscopic layer of water on the ice.
You weigh slightly less at the equator than at the North Pole because Earth bulges outward there.
Dropping a permanent magnet repeatedly scrambles its internal atomic alignment and causes it to lose its magnetism.
Pure water is actually an electrical insulator, but dissolved minerals and impurities make it a strong conductor.
Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes and twenty seconds to travel across space to Earth.
Sound waves travel over four times faster in water than they do through the air.
Rubbing your hands together converts kinetic energy into thermal energy through friction, making your skin feel warm.
The food you eat contains chemical potential energy that your body converts into kinetic energy for movement.
When you lift a ball, your arm acts as a third-class lever with the effort between the fulcrum and load.
An electromagnet only produces a magnetic field while an electrical current is actively flowing through its wire coil.
Light bends when passing from air into water, causing a submerged straw to appear broken or bent.
